title: Alien dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dancing alien -->
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='16' ry='20' fill='#5ee06a'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='10' ry='13' fill='#8df09a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='15' ry='14' fill='#4fd85c'/>
  <!-- head shine -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='25' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#a6f5b0'/>
  <!-- big eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='29' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#c9ffd0'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='29' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#c9ffd0'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='30' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#1f3a2a'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='30' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#1f3a2a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 37 Q50 42 56 37' stroke='#2f7a3a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <line x1='42' y1='17' x2='36' y2='8' stroke='#3aa847' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='17' x2='64' y2='8' stroke='#3aa847' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='7' r='3' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='7' r='3' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- left arm up, waving -->
  <path d='M35 50 Q22 42 20 30' stroke='#4fd85c' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='19' cy='28' r='4' fill='#7ce88a'/>
  <!-- right arm out -->
  <path d='M65 52 Q80 54 86 44' stroke='#4fd85c' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='87' cy='42' r='4' fill='#7ce88a'/>
  <!-- dancing legs -->
  <path d='M43 76 Q38 86 30 88' stroke='#4fd85c' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M57 76 Q63 85 72 87' stroke='#4fd85c' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='90' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#ff8f4f'/>
  <ellipse cx='75' cy='89' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#ff8f4f'/>
  <!-- spot decorations -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='55' r='2' fill='#ff6ec7'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='63' r='2.5' fill='#ff6ec7'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='1.8' fill='#ff6ec7'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <circle cx='84' cy='22' r='3' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <line x1='86.5' y1='22' x2='86.5' y2='11' stroke='#ffd23f' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M86.5 11 Q92 12 91 17' stroke='#ffd23f' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
</svg>
